svg.title: Five questions before an open source tool goes on a live job
svg.desc: Is it somebody's day job; what does the licence oblige you to do; can you get your data out; what does it cost to run; and who supports it when it breaks on a Friday.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI", Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Before it goes on a live job

svg.text: Five questions that matter more than the star count.
